comment: A person's attempt at a course test.

columns.name: id
columns.comment: Surrogate identifier for the submission, auto-generated by the database and unique across the whole system.

columns.name: course_person_id
columns.comment: The course-person (person + course + role) this submission was made by.

columns.name: course_test_id
columns.comment: The test this submission is an attempt at. The course referenced by course_person_id and the course referenced by course_test_id must be the same course; that rule is not enforced at the database level, only expected of the data.

columns.name: submitted_time
columns.comment: Date and time the submission was made.

columns.name: submission_text
columns.comment: Optional submitted answer text, capped at 4000 characters (SQL Server's largest non-MAX NVARCHAR size) rather than using the unbounded text type.

columns.name: attempt_number
columns.comment: Which attempt this is for this course-person on this test (1st, 2nd, ...). Unique together with campus_id, course_person_id, and course_test_id: the same attempt number can't be recorded twice for the same course-person/test.
